Current Rapid plan page sells one-time list prices of $145 / $209 / $356 / $463 for 25K / 50K / 100K / 150K. Evaluation uses EOD trailing drawdown; the Sim Funded stage uses intraday trailing drawdown and the floor locks at +$100 after the buffer is secured.
The evaluation target is 6% (the official rules table gives $1,500 / $3,000 / $6,000 / $9,000 by size), with 2 minimum trading days and a 50% evaluation-only consistency rule.

The funded stage has no daily loss limit or consistency rule, a 90/10 split, a $500 minimum payout, and a required buffer of $1,100 / $2,100 / $3,100 / $4,600 by size, built in realized profits. payoutFirstDays 1 = the 24-hour wait after the first Sim Funded trade; the request also needs the buffer and minimum (help 13134709: "Your first payout becomes available exactly 24 hours after your first trade on the Sim Funded account (as long as you meet the buffer and minimum)."). No per-cycle payout cap is published for Rapid.
The firm-wide restricted-country article lists Russia. A trader located in Russia cannot purchase a new account.
